diagnostics.message: `google_compute_shared_vpc_service_project.shared_vpc_service` attaches this project as a Shared VPC service project, which requires the Compute Engine API to be enabled in the service project. It has no dependency on `google_project_service.project_services`, whereas its sibling host-project resources (`google_compute_shared_vpc_host_project.shared_vpc_host`, and `...service_projects` transitively) explicitly declare that dependency. Add `depends_on = [google_project_service.project_services]`.

`output.service_accounts` exposes the project's default service accounts (`local.service_accounts_default` - compute, cloudbuild, gae, workstations), but it does not depend on `google_project_default_service_accounts.default_service_accounts`, which can delete/deprivilege those very accounts. Consumers of this output can therefore act on accounts that are being removed. Add it to the output's `depends_on`.

`google_kms_crypto_key_iam_member.service_identity_cmek` already depends on `google_project.project` implicitly: its `member` references `local.service_accounts_robots`, which is built from `local.project.number`, which references `google_project.project.0.number`. The explicit `depends_on` entry duplicates that ordering and can be dropped.

`google_kms_crypto_key_iam_member.service_identity_cmek` already depends on `data.google_project.project` implicitly via the same chain (`member` -> `local.service_accounts_robots` -> `local.project.number` -> `data.google_project.project.0.number` for the existing-project case). The explicit `depends_on` entry is redundant.
